    AI Overview
    Lead capture form builders are tools that let you create customized forms to collect prospect contact details, often in exchange for resources or newsletters. They help convert anonymous website visitors into qualified leads and typically integrate directly with your CRM or email marketing software to automate follow-ups. 
    Top-rated options tailored to different business needs include: 
    • HubSpot: Best for all-in-one CRM integration, allowing you to automatically sync captured leads to your pipeline and nurture them.
    • Jotform: Best for robust, mobile-ready forms and extensive design customization without requiring coding.
    • Formstack: Best for teams prioritizing compliance and advanced conversion tools, like capturing partial submissions.
    • Weavely: Best for generating AI-powered forms from a simple prompt and syncing data straight to tools like Google Sheets. 
    To help you choose the best builder for your workflow, tell me:
    • What is your primary website platform (e.g., WordPress, Shopify, custom site)?
    • Do you need the form to connect to a specific CRM or email marketing tool?
    • Are you looking for basic contact forms or complex multi-step lead qualification quizzes?
